question: Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter 'C'.
solution:

question: Three different positions of the same dice are shown (figures 1 to 3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face having '3'.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 2.

In the first and second dice, 2 and 5 are common. So, the remaining face will be opposite to each other. Hence, 1 is opposite to 6.

In the second and third dice, 1 and 2 are common. So, the remaining face will be opposite to each other. Hence, 4 is opposite to 5.

So, the remaining opposite pair is 3 and 2.

question: Select the cube that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.
options:
Only D

Only A and C

Only C and D

Only B
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. Only C and D.

When the sheet is folded along the lines, the opposite pairs are;

1 is opposite to 3.

2 is opposite to 4.

5 is opposite to 6.

In dice A and B, opposite pair 5 and 6 are adjacent to each other. Hence, this cube cannot be formed.

In dice C and D, no opposite pairs are adjacent to each other. Hence, both these cubes can be formed.
question_hi: उस घन का चयन कीजिए, जो दी गई शीट को रेखाओं पर मोड़कर बनाया जा सकता है।
options_hi:
केवल D

केवल A और C

केवल C और D

केवल B
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् केवल C और D है।

जब शीट को रेखाओं पर मोड़ा जाता है, तो विपरीत युग्म हैं;

1, 3 के विपरीत है।

2, 4 के विपरीत है।

5, 6 के विपरीत है।

पासे A और B में, विपरीत युग्म 5 और 6 एक दूसरे के निकटस्थ हैं। अत: यह घन नहीं बनाया जा सकता है।

पासे C और D में, कोई विपरीत युग्म एक दूसरे के निकटस्थ नहीं हैं। अत: ये दोनों घन बनाए जा सकते हैं।

question: Two positions of the same cubical block are shown. When '6' is at the top, which number will be at the bottom?

So, 4 is opposite to 6.
